title: Slovakian Pancakes with Date Syrup
description: A traditional Slovakian dish with a twist of sweet date syrup. Perfect for a lazy Sunday breakfast.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, eggs, milk, date syrup, and salt until smooth.
2. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
3. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop batter onto the pan.
4. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface.
5. Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes, until golden brown.
6. Repeat with remaining batter, until all pancakes are cooked.
7. Serve warm with melted butter and additional date syrup, if desired.
